verdict.rationale: No built-in funnel analytics dashboard appears in the evidence. The optional event webhook reports progress through verification data gathering, and decision webhooks report outcomes, so a founder could build pass-rate and drop-off tracking with their own tooling. The Customer Portal Verifications page covers per-session review, not aggregate analytics. Missing for 10: native funnel or analytics dashboard, pass-rate and drop-off reporting, completion-time metrics, country and document-type breakdowns, any independent corroboration.
